enumeration_method: Two enumerations, run separately. (A) help.bizagi.com: the ToC iframe (hmcontent.htm) was parsed to 1644 flat .htm topic ids; EVERY one of the 1644 was then fetched and judged (221 had been reached first through the docs' public Swiftype index; the remaining 1423 were fetched by direct HTTP in this pass, of which 1 could not be retrieved and carry BLOCKED rows). The 1644 are judged on the page body plus every image filename and alt text, so a topic whose body carries no AI token is still checked for AI-named figures. (B) www.bizagi.com: sitemap.xml (en) gave 645 URLs; all 577 content URLs (non-asset) were fetched, 574 successfully; the 238 of them whose body mentions AI had every one of their content images viewed before the row was re-issued.
note: The assignment brief estimated a population of ~20. The unfiltered sweep required by shared rule 6 shows the AI vocabulary in these docs is far larger: 222 topics carry an AI/agent/bot token, of which only 32 sit in the AI Hub branch - the facet check therefore EXPANDED the population instead of narrowing it; all 221 fetchable flagged topics are judged here. 110 of them contain a standalone AI/LLM/GPT token in the body; 111 contain none (their token was a non-AI use of bot/agent/knowledge base) and are excluded as mechanical E2 rows. The brief's C2 note is satisfied: help.bizagi.com 'Standards support' and 'Exporting to BPMN' pages were fetched; the BPMN element vocabulary is documented in tasks.htm ('An AI Task is performed by an AI Agent.'). Marketing-page figures were triaged by filename signal across all 574 pages and every diagram-named figure (151 distinct assets) was viewed in batch contact sheets; hero-art-only pages are E0 rows whose note records that method. | AMENDMENT 2026-09-24 (orchestrator review): (1) the keyword-narrowed docs population was a recall gap - the frontier and the ledger now cover all 1644 ToC topics, not only the 221 with an AI token; the 1423 additional topics are judged from the fetched body plus every image filename and alt text, and each carries judged_from=http-fetch. (2) 238 www.bizagi.com rows whose page mentions AI were re-issued after viewing every content image on those pages (thumbnail contact sheets: 628 raster images, plus 252 SVGs scanned for label text and the process-drawn ones viewed at native resolution). Result of both re-looks: no marketing page carries a BPMN diagram with an AI element - the AI-bearing marketing figures are product-UI mocks and step timelines (not BPMN), and the two real BPMN models on the marketing site (invoice approval, employee onboarding) have no AI element. 6 image assets could not be downloaded and are recorded in the row notes.
